solo-shliakh-do-sebe:
The “Solo” Collection: A Journey Within

Unique Ukrainian brand OBIIMY presents its new Solo Collection. It brings together silk scarf prints that tell stories of inner strength, freedom, and a woman’s journey back to herself. The collection draws inspiration from vintage fashion magazine covers and the iconic actresses of the 1940s and 1950s.

The starting point for the creation of Solo was a series of seven original prints. Each one represents a distinct state of a woman’s inner world.

The Solo Collection is our invitation to reclaim the right to beauty within the life you are living right now.

The touch of silk that women living through the wartime 1940s once longed for is now embodied in seven original OBIIMY prints — seven different states along a woman’s journey back to herself. Each scarf offers countless ways for a woman to express who she is to the world.

Solo — Women’s Strength Through the Decades

Fashion has always been more than clothing. It became a language through which women spoke about themselves, their freedom, character, and place in the world.

The Solo Collection tells the story of an accessory that has evolved alongside the image of women throughout the decades.

In the 1950s, strength began to be expressed through impeccable elegance. The silk scarf brought refinement and confidence back to the feminine silhouette, revealing character beneath its outward softness.

Over time, the rules of fashion grew bolder. Women experimented with colors, shapes, and new forms of self-expression. The scarf became a striking accent — a detail capable of transforming the mood of an entire look.

These transformations can be seen on vintage fashion magazine covers and in photographs from the past century, which became one of the sources of inspiration for the signature Solo Collection.

Eras, silhouettes, and ideas of femininity changed, yet the silk scarf remained by a woman’s side.

Because femininity does not contradict strength, and true freedom begins with the right to be yourself.

Seven Silk Scarves — Seven States of the Solo Woman

The signature Solo Collection by OBIIMY is designed as an inner journey. Seven original prints symbolize seven states we experience as we search for ourselves, embrace change, make decisions, and learn to trust ourselves more deeply.

The “Spark” Silk Scarf is about inner energy, the courage to be seen, and the power to initiate change.

The “Flirt” Silk Scarf embodies optimism, lightness, faith in victory, and the art of effortless femininity. It is about enjoying who you are, playing with your style, savoring life, and allowing yourself to feel light even when the world becomes too serious.

The “Pulse” Silk Scarf speaks to the natural strength within you. It is about a life you truly want to live — about your own rhythm, which remains with you even when almost everything around you changes.

The “Golden Light” Silk Scarf captures the state that comes after a long search, when you no longer need to look outside yourself for answers. Everything gradually falls into place, and the next step becomes clear.

The “Adventure” Silk Scarf is about the freedom of not knowing where the next turn will lead, yet still saying “Yes” to a new experience.

The “Silence Within” Silk Scarf represents a state in which you no longer need to prove yourself or live up to the expectations of others. It is an inner balance that allows you to accept yourself along your own path.

The “Bold Step” Silk Scarf completes the inner journey of the signature Solo Collection. After searching, doubt, discovery, and silence comes the moment to move forward. Not because fear has disappeared, but because something more powerful has emerged — trust in yourself.

Solo by OBIIMY — More Than a Silk Scarf Collection

In a world of fast fashion, the Solo Collection by OBIIMY offers silk accessories with meaning — pieces that transcend a single season and gradually become part of their owner’s personal story.

It is a story of freedom — the freedom to embrace change within yourself at any stage of your life.

spivocha-dusha:
"Singing Soul" collection

It is dedicated to the rare birds of Ukraine as a reminder of the fragility and value of all living things that need our care. Each print is like the voice of a bird singing its unique story on silk.

Our goal is to support and preserve the rare bird, the siberian spoonbill. This most colorful migratory bird of Ukraine is listed in the Red Book. Its number is decreasing due to the loss of nesting sites and the war.

Part of the proceeds from the sale of the collection's items are used to make and install nests for the titmouse. Join the charity initiative!
